Placemaker.Recipe.Plaza.Description: A walkable paved square with a centerpiece and seating.
Placemaker.Plaza.Name: Plaza
Placemaker.Plaza.furniture.Tooltip: How many times the furniture arrangement is placed. Around the centre they come in facing pairs.
Placemaker.Plaza.centerSize.Tooltip: Space kept free around the centerpiece (radius). Raise it for a bigger fountain.
Placemaker.Plaza.arrangement.Tooltip: Up to five items placed side by side, for example bench – lamp – bench.
Placemaker.Plaza.walkable.Tooltip: Lets pedestrians cross the whole plaza freely instead of only along paths.
Placemaker.Plaza.access.Tooltip: Click the outline where people enter. Without any, access points are suggested along adjacent streets.
Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.CenterpieceDoesNo: The centerpiece does not fit this plaza and was left out.
Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.NoRoomForAmenity: There is no free room for the {0} on this square.
Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.AmenityMoved: The {0} did not fit at the chosen position and was placed elsewhere.
Placemaker.Plaza.Issue.TooSmallForLevels: The square is too small for these levels (needs about 24 × 16 m).
